ns2:section.sectionText: In this action learning course, students will be working with an Amazon e-tailer to grow its business. Working in teams, students will gain hands-on experience in designing, planning, and executing advertising campaigns for an ecommerce enterprise. Enrollment is by instructor approval only. Students can earn a maximum of 6 hours for the Amazon Advertising Experience courses. Students can earn a maximum of 6 hours for the Amazon Advertising Experience. This includes credits earned under ADV 392 and ADV 400. For design and pedagogical reasons, ADV 400 should follow ADV 392; they should not be taken in the same semester. Interested students must apply by August 1, 2022 for consideration. Students will be admitted on a rolling basis throughout Summer 2022. For more information and a link to the application go to: https://brandhub.illinois.edu/amazon-ads-experience/
